# Tooltician

Tooltician provides operations teams, founders, and finance teams with high-reliability Python automation, custom ETL data pipelines, fail-closed financial/reconciliation tooling, and web technical hygiene consulting. Built to keep running after handoff.

- **Primary URL:** [tooltician.com](https://tooltician.com)
- **Sitemap Index:** [sitemap-index.xml](https://tooltician.com/sitemap-index.xml)
- **Full Content & Detail Spec:** [llms-full.txt](https://tooltician.com/llms-full.txt)
- **Language Support:** English (default at `/en/`), Spanish (at `/es/`)
- **Root (x-default landing):** [tooltician.com](https://tooltician.com)
  - Bilingual entry point with public proof, service links, and brief CTAs. Only returning visitors with a stored language preference are forwarded; there is no browser-language auto-redirect.

## Pricing Model

- Every service follows the same staged pricing model: **diagnostic → scoped build → optional retainer**. No amount is published without its stage label.
- Chile/LATAM engagements are quoted in UF (Unidades de Fomento); international engagements are delivered in English and quoted in USD.

## Primary Offerings & Pages

- **English Home:** [tooltician.com/en](https://tooltician.com/en/)
  - Portfolio, track record, and intake brief for English-speaking clients.
- **Spanish Home:** [tooltician.com/es](https://tooltician.com/es/)
  - Evidencia de trabajo en producción y brief para el mercado hispanohablante.
- **Python Automation & ETL Pipelines**
  - Robust, automated workflows that replace manual data entry and fragile scripts.
  - EN: [Python Automation](https://tooltician.com/en/services/python-automation/)
  - ES: [Automatización Python](https://tooltician.com/es/servicios/automatizacion-python/)
- **Recurring Data Collection**
  - Lawful, repeatable acquisition from public or authorized sources with validation, alerts, and documented repair paths.
  - EN: [Recurring Data Collection](https://tooltician.com/en/services/recurring-data-collection/)
  - ES: [Recolección Recurrente de Datos](https://tooltician.com/es/servicios/recoleccion-recurrente-datos/)
- **Internal Tools & APIs**
  - Fast, maintainable internal interfaces (FastAPI, CLIs) that eliminate tribal knowledge.
  - EN: [Internal Tools & APIs](https://tooltician.com/en/services/internal-tools/)
  - ES: [Herramientas Internas y APIs](https://tooltician.com/es/servicios/herramientas-internas/)
- **Web Technical Hygiene & Hardening**
  - External security reviews, header injection (HSTS, CSP), DNS authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and form security.
  - EN: [Web Technical Hygiene](https://tooltician.com/en/services/web-technical-hygiene/)
  - ES: [Higiene Técnica Web](https://tooltician.com/es/servicios/higiene-tecnica-web/)
- **Financial Tooling & Reconciliation**
  - Deterministic audit trails and fail-closed ledger reconciliation matching correctness over convenience.
  - EN: [Financial Tooling](https://tooltician.com/en/services/financial-tooling/)
  - ES: [Herramientas Financieras](https://tooltician.com/es/servicios/herramientas-financieras/)
- **Static Sites & Front Ends**
  - High-performance, lightweight, SEO-friendly static layouts (Astro) that rank and load instantly.
  - EN: [Static Sites & Front Ends](https://tooltician.com/en/services/static-sites/)
  - ES: [Sitios Estáticos y Frontends](https://tooltician.com/es/servicios/sitios-web/)
